bundled.name: FFmpeg
bundled.note: Fetched on install from ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de, pinned by SHA-256, and used for recording, exporting, frame sampling, audio and measuring footage. Built with --enable-gpl --enable-version3, x264 and x265. Statically linked, so a distributor also needs the source and licences of every other library its -buildconf enables. Source: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html

bundled.name: eSpeak NG
bundled.note: Turns text into phonemes for the Kokoro voice. Compiled to JavaScript inside Talkie's own build of the phonemizer package, and runs only in Kokoro's separate worker process, never inside Talkie itself. Built from eSpeak NG commit b774a8fd712e2b43510c1cb6c2b8cd3f22fe0a86 (https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng/archive/b774a8fd712e2b43510c1cb6c2b8cd3f22fe0a86.tar.gz) with two small patches; the patches, the build script and how to run it ship with the app in node_modules/phonemizer (BUILD.md).
